mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order (order_no, account_id, security_code, side, order_type, order_price, quantity, amount, filled_quantity, filled_amount, last_exec_seq, event_version, status, business_date, exchange_order_id, cancel_requested_at, client_order_id) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{accountId}, #{securityCode}, #{side}, #{orderType}, #{orderPrice}, #{quantity}, #{amount}, #{filledQuantity}, #{filledAmount}, #{lastExecSeq}, #{eventVersion}, #{status}, #{businessDate}, #{exchangeOrderId}, #{cancelRequestedAt}, #{clientOrderId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_order WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND client_order_id = #{clientOrderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_order SET status = 'ACKNOWLEDGED', exchange_order_id = #{exchangeOrderId}, event_version = event_version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'SUBMITTED'
UPDATE t_order SET status = 'REJECTED', event_version = event_version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'SUBMITTED'

UPDATE t_order SET filled_quantity = filled_quantity + #{quantity}, filled_amount = filled_amount + #{amount}, last_exec_seq = GREATEST(COALESCE(last_exec_seq, 0), #{execSeq}), event_version = event_version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status IN ('ACKNOWLEDGED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED') AND filled_quantity + #{quantity} <= quantity

UPDATE t_order SET status = CASE WHEN filled_quantity = quantity THEN 'FILLED' ELSE 'PARTIALLY_FILLED' END WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status IN ('ACKNOWLEDGED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED') AND status <> CASE WHEN filled_quantity = quantity THEN 'FILLED' ELSE 'PARTIALLY_FILLED' END
UPDATE t_order SET cancel_requested_at = NOW(3), event_version = event_version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status IN ('ACKNOWLEDGED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED') AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL
UPDATE t_order SET status = 'CANCELED', event_version = event_version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status IN ('ACKNOWLEDGED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED') AND filled_quantity < quantity
